thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: p99 latency alert on /v1/streaming/generate (hosted) > 4.5s for last 5m. SLO breach p99. Triggering incident channel.

ops-jess: I got the page, grabbing oncall.

sara (oncall): ack. I'm on it. first pass: is this global or region-specific?

mike (eng-runtime): seeing spikes in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. p95 ~ 800ms -> normal, p99 spikes to 4.5-6s. Streaming stalls and partial chunks.

jun (eng-ml): this started ~8m after the int8 quantization rollout for model-redwood-small v2; rollout was at 1794202000. Any correlation with calibration job?

nina (sre): correlating. I see an increase in KV cache misses and heavy page-in ops on the GPU host nodes. Logs show repeated dequantization retries.

mike (eng-runtime): paste logs: 
```
[1794203120] model-redwood-small-v2: quant_calib: apply profile int8-fast
[1794203125] session=abcd: kvcache: miss -> fetch_from_kvstore (disk)
[1794203130] dequantize: fallback retry=1
[1794203131] stream: send_chunk timeout 2500ms
[1794203135] session=efgh: stall detected, stall_count=3
```

ops-jess: @alex can you surface any customer tickets?

alex (cs): got 2_INC high-pri from customers in EU complaining about partial responses and long streaming times. One on Dedicated (customer-acme) and another hosted. I told them we're investigating.

luis (infra): host-level metrics: page faults up 8x on the GPU nodes running quantized model instances. Memory working set dropped as KV cache eviction increased. Might be a quant-profile memory regression.

sara (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) pause the quant rollout; 2) enable fp16 fallback for the model; 3) scale up worker pool by 20% and enable burst nodes; 4) clear KV caches where safe. Thoughts?

mike (eng-runtime): agree. Also set routing to prefer older model version (v1.9) for traffic where possible to avoid mass fallback. I'll open a hotfix to flip the runtime default to fp16 for the model family.

jun (eng-ml): pause is good. Note: the int8 calibration introduced a smaller KV cache footprint per token but the dequantization hotpath triggers extra temporary allocations, which may be thrashing the GPU memory allocator. Might be allocator fragmentation + calibration variant.

nina (sre): I'll start scaling pools and enable burst capacity. Also adding a temporary eviction throttle to avoid simultaneous cache flushes across hosts (we don't want a stampede).

incident-bot: ACTIONS: pause_rollout(model-redwood-small-v2, 1794202000) requested by sara (oncall) at 1794203180.

mike (eng-runtime): Applied runtime flip to prefer fp16 for model-redwood-small-v2 in hosted region configs. Rolling update started.

ops-jess: /pagerduty acknowledge incident 12345 (sara)

sara (oncall): acked. Starting KV cache flush on a staggered schedule: every 30s per host. Nina coordinating IDs.

luis (infra): KV flush jobs scheduled across hosts to avoid concurrent disk pressure. Also bumped ephemeral disk IO QoS for these nodes.

jun (eng-ml): quick mitigation note: we can also disable the int8 dequant retry path while preserving the profile. That avoids the retry loop causing extra allocations. I'll prepare a small hotpatch but might take 15-20m to deploy.

mike (eng-runtime): streaming errors reduced after fp16 flip. p99 dropping: 6s -> 2.2s in us-west-2 within 7m. p95 stable.

alex (cs): pinging impacted customers with an update: "We're investigating a performance regression after a model quantization rollout; temporary mitigation is enabling fp16 fallback and scaling capacity. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA."

ops-jess: customer message posted to ACME and hosted contacts.

sara (oncall): we should decide whether to rollback the int8 profile for now. If dequant hotpath is causing fragmentation that can't be mitigated quickly, rollback is safer.

jun (eng-ml): I'll signal rollback if p99 doesn't reach < 1s sustained in 30m. Hotpatch to disable retries is in review now (PR #4872).

nina (sre): monitoring: p99 trending down: 2.2s -> 1.5s after cache throttle + fp16. Disk IO and page faults halved. Streaming stalls count reduced.

mike (eng-runtime): rolling hotpatch to disable dequant retry applied to 30% traffic; no errors reported. Continuing rollout.

luis (infra): note: Dedicated cluster for customer-acme still showing occasional stalls. I recommend a per-customer routing pin to v1.9 until full validation.

sara (oncall): doing per-customer pin for acme now.

alex (cs): Acme acknowledged temporary routing pin. Asking for ETA on permanent fix — they want a follow-up in 2 hours.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place: fp16 fallback enabled, KV throttle active, allocator hotpatch rolling. Customer impact: partial responses / streaming stalls, reduced after mitigations.

ops-jess: ops checklist: create incident doc, add timeline, attach logs, assign postmortem owner.

sara (oncall): I'll draft the incident doc. Assigning postmortem to jun (eng-ml) + mike (eng-runtime). Alex to coordinate customer comms. Nina to collect SLO graphs.

jun (eng-ml): taking postmortem lead. I'll include calibration test gaps and reproduce plan. Also adding a regression test for allocator fragmentation under int8 calibration.

mike (eng-runtime): follow-up actions I need: 1) add a graceful fallback path that doesn't allocate extra buffers on retry; 2) improve rollout canary to include page fault and GPU allocator metrics; 3) slower rollout throttle.

nina (sre): agree. I'll add alerting rule: p99+ pagefault rate correlation and auto-rollback trigger if sustained >2m.

sara (oncall): final status for channel: mitigated, customer pinned where needed, monitoring stable but we'll keep this P1 open until postmortem + follow-ups.

alex (cs): sent update to customers that we've mitigated and are doing a postmortem with ETA in 2 hours.

ops-jess: closing the immediate paging cycle. Keep P1 open. If anything regresses, reopen channel. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED? no — status: MITIGATED. Acknowledge to close incident once postmortem draft added.

sara (oncall): adding notes to incident doc and tagging owners. Thanks everyone.

jun (eng-ml): starting repro job on staging with int8 calib + KV stress harness. Will report reproduction steps in the doc.

mike (eng-runtime): noted. I'll prepare a small runtime patch to avoid heavy allocations during dequant path before re-enabling any int8 rollout.

nina (sre): retention: capturing stack traces and allocator dumps from affected hosts and storing in /incidents/1794203123/artifacts.

alex (cs): customers confirm degraded UX is resolved for now. We'll monitor for 24h and update SLA incident status.

(END OF THREAD)
